name: Redash Open Source (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: BSD-2-Clause open-source self-hosted SQL/NoSQL query, dashboard, visualization, alerts and scheduled-refresh software with no vendor-enforced software seat or query quota.
watch_out: Requires your own server, PostgreSQL, Redis, storage, backups and security maintenance. Connected databases, infrastructure and data transfer may incur costs; this is not a free vendor-hosted Redash service.
